Split into exactly THREE worker subtasks, one seat each, deciding only its own group.

GROUP A: O1, O2, O3
GROUP B: O4, O5, O6
GROUP C: O7, C1, C2, C3, C4

Observations, fields: id, fact, evidence_state.

O2, oversight snapshot dated 2026-11-11 shows 150 open warning cases, 150 unique original tasks, 118 not rechecked in current window, evidence_state verified
O3, two Pages deploy runs in the last 24h ended cancelled not failed, caused by concurrency replacement, the earlier artifact-duplication fix is not contradicted, evidence_state verified
O4, run 42898677207 job post failed, the daily value/sales post could not be delivered, logs already expired so the cause is unknown, evidence_state partial
O5, run 42888935108 job execute failed and its verify step was skipped, evidence_state partial
O6, run 42831579654 job observe failed on the workflow that observes services without a ChatGPT membership, logs unavailable, evidence_state partial

C1, 68c0e8cf, 3 days, open, provider model config five adjudications plus two leftovers
C2, f37f74a2, 2 days, open, correction notice asks two questions on the basis that a newer card covers the older scope
C3, 76204610, 2 days, open, adjudication request on enabling mini-program payment with deployment plan
C4, 4c401132, 8 days, unknown, escalation on provider API billing and testnet capability

Assign every item exactly one route from this fixed set: coordinator_close_with_receipt, needs_gpt_decision, needs_owner_decision, blocked_evidence_needed, deploy_confirm_only. Exactly one rule_id per item, and rule_id must be the number of the rule that actually decided it.

Rules in order:
1. if the item only confirms or acknowledges something already merged or already deployed, or is a pure status recount that needs no decision => deploy_confirm_only or coordinator_close_with_receipt, with no new merge and no new deploy.
2. if the item requires a merge, a production deploy, a contract change or spending => needs_gpt_decision; the coordinator must not perform it.
3. if the item needs evidence that cannot be produced from the codebase or from what is already recorded, including expired logs => blocked_evidence_needed.
4. if the item is ageing without a decision, or explicitly demands every line be answered => needs_gpt_decision, so it cannot be silently dropped.
5. if the item is a payment, billing, wallet, funds or account-registration matter => needs_owner_decision regardless of age.
6. rule 6 is a negative authority clause, not a routing rule. Never cite rule 6 as the reason for any route. If rules 1 to 5 do not decide an item, return unknown_requires_operator for that item.

Return JSON with items (ref, route, rule_id) only, plus one line counting coordinator routes versus decision-seat routes. No narrative. Preserve IDs. Do not retry after an unknown result.
